title: fix: merge eligible PRs before post-verification acceptance
body:
Open, green, mergeable PRs were sent to evidence collection and senior adjudication until every original requirement had final acceptance PASS. That is a post-verification closure condition: Workflows #4183’s retained snapshot satisfied the objective screen but could not reach the merge guard.

Separate objective premerge eligibility from post-verifier acceptance. Eligible merges use the existing fresh exact-head guard without a model call. A confirmed merge creates one bound verification successor through the existing native pipeline. Positively qualified remote-only actions ignore inferred unrelated repository/workspace fallbacks while preserving exact target/source/branch, explicit unresolved history and uncertain reservations. Known pre-callback refusals use supported hold-only reconciliation and retain completed assessments.

Closer explicitly opts out of the optional immediate adversarial panel (`--skip-immediate-advisory`); the bound verifier and existing post-response agents evaluate acceptance. This does not promise a later invocation of that extra panel. Other callers’ default panel behavior and its explicit BLOCKED-follow-up API remain unchanged. Required runtime acceptance gates, checks, review threads and exact-head mutation guards remain mandatory. This follows the advisory/required-gate distinction in ORCHESTRATOR.md.

Validation: 790 integrated tests passed before review follow-ups. Targeted producer/consumer regressions cover top-level refusal proof mapping, declared historical aliases, malformed history after mapped-key expansion and later raw-queue claim expansion. The first full CI exposed 51 tests using the former premerge model stage; their fixtures now exercise actual post-verifier assessment while retaining transport, proof and no-replay assertions. The final integrated affected-test run passed 1,069 tests in77.98s, including pinned Core contracts and real process-ownership probes. Black, Ruff and seven-source-file mypy passed. Collection measured 8,122 (main 8,031 plus 91); all ceilings remain unchanged. No full-suite PASS, deployment or live cohort merge is claimed yet.

Broader collection-schema/source-role and opener handoff repairs remain separate. Native automation publication/settings are excluded.
